basic_details.job_title: IIITDM Kancheepuram Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM), Kancheepuram, an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, has invited retired employees to apply for 1 post of Consultant (on contract) on a short-term contract, initially for one year. Applications must be sent by email to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026, at a consolidated pay of Rs.45,000 per month.

qualification.details: Eligibility: retired officers from Central government, Central autonomous bodies/IIT/NITs etc., who have retired in GP 4600/4800 and above. Experience: the officer should be well experienced in any areas of Administrative, Academic, Purchase, Audit and Accounts matters. Age: not exceeding 63 years as on the date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Pay: consolidated, Rs.45,000/- per month. The notice does not print any Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport Facility or Medical Reimbursement for the consultant. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility details of the post.

selection_process: The notice mentions an interview. The date and time will be intimated by email to shortlisted candidates. The interview place is the Administration Building
Chennai-600 127. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview.
important_instructions: The initial appointment is for one year and may be extended by the authority based on satisfactory performance. The engagement is temporary and can be cancelled at any time by IIITDM Kancheepuram by giving a month's notice either side without assigning any reason. Either side may also end it with a month's salary in lieu of notice. The consultant will observe the office timings and holidays of IIITDM Kancheepuram and shall not take up private business or professional activity in conflict with the interest of the Government. For official journeys or tours, TA/DA is as applicable to the consultant at the time of retirement. Incidental Leave of 18 days per annum (1.5 days per completed month of service) is admissible. No other leave is admissible, leave cannot be carried beyond the calendar year, and un-availed leave is not encashed. The consultant must abide by the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, and keep the work confidential. The consultant must hand over all records and accounts to the designated person before the contract ends and before final payment is released. Services may be terminated if the work is not satisfactory, any information furnished proves false or is wilfully suppressed, terms are breached, or the consultant is involved in indiscipline, misconduct or any act unbecoming of the consultant. On the form, the candidate declares that false, incorrect or incomplete information or ineligibility found at any time before or after selection makes the candidature liable to rejection.

content_sections.heading: About IIITDM Kancheepuram
content_sections.text: According to the notice, IIITDM Kancheepuram was established in 2007 by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and is located on the outskirts of Chennai. It describes itself as a Centre of Excellence for design and manufacturing oriented engineering education and research.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I of the notice), which can be downloaded from the website www.iiitdm.ac.in . The application, together with copies of the relevant documents, may be submitted by email to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026. The notice does not print a subject line for the email. The notice does not ask for a postal application. Contact details printed in the notice: 044-27476312/6313, email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility: retired officers from Central government, Central autonomous bodies/IIT/NITs etc., who have retired in GP 4600/4800 and above. The notice prints no age relaxation. Pay: consolidated, Rs.45,000/- per month. The notice does not print any Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport Facility or Medical Reimbursement for the consultant. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility details of the post.

rows.pay: Consolidated pay of Rs.45,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram Consultant (On contract) Job Description
content_sections.text: The officer should be well experienced in any areas of Administrative, Academic, Purchase, Audit and Accounts matters. Well versed in noting and drafting and correspondence with Ministry, other offices etc. Proficiency in usage of MS Office/MS Excel etc.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice asks for copies of all relevant documents with the application: Copy of PPO Retirement order Certificate/Degree Proof of date of birth Identification proof such as Aadhar Card or PAN Card The Annexure-I form also lists identity proof, proof of address, copy of PPO and copies of proofs of educational qualifications as enclosures, and asks for a passport photo of the candidate to be affixed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an interview. The date and time will be intimated by email to shortlisted candidates. The interview place is the Administration Building, IIITDM Kancheepuram, Melakkottaiyur, Vandalur - Kelambakkam Road, Chennai-600 127. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Consultant (On contract).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted by email on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired officers from Central government, Central autonomous bodies/IIT/NITs etc., who have retired in GP 4600/4800 and above, can apply. The notice invites applications from retired employees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 63 years as on the date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIITDM Kancheepuram Consultant?
faq.answer: A consolidated pay of Rs.45,000/- per month is offered.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed proforma from www.iiitdm.ac.in and send it with copies of the documents to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Copy of PPO, retirement order, certificate/degree, proof of date of birth and identification proof such as Aadhar Card or PAN Card, as named in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview at the Administration Building of IIITDM Kancheepuram, and the date and time are intimated by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for an initial period of one year, which may be extended by the authority based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will the consultant get DA or other allowances on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The notice states the consultant is not entitled to any allowance such as Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport Facility and Medical Reimbursement.
